notes: Resolves the updater Python executable from the active virtual environment or repo-local environment before falling back to the running interpreter.
Launches application updates and rollbacks with a detached child process so the updater can continue after the main app closes.
Writes launcher diagnostics to local/update_logs/app_update_launcher_*.log before the standalone updater starts.
Reports immediate updater process exits with the launcher log path instead of silently treating them as successful launches.
Keeps release-aware update, rollback, offline bundle, firmware, device protocol, motion, and pressure-control behavior unchanged.
summary: Hardens the app updater subprocess launcher and adds launcher diagnostics.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
